From: Maria Sanchez <maria.sanchez@brewtechlabs.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Inference Cafe pop-up series — quick ask

Hi Soojin,

Hope you are well — we loved Redwood's demo at EdgeSummit and would like to propose a small co-hosted series we're calling 'Inference Cafe' for August and September in three US cities (SF, Austin, NYC). The format is a 2-hour pop-up with a short joint demo (20m), product Q+A, and a hosted coffee hour for local dev/ML teams.

High level asks from BrewTech:
- Redwood provides 1 speaker for the demo and 2 staffers to support the booth per city
- We split exhibitor fee and local promo (social + Meetup boost) 50/50
- Requesting MDF to cover venue coffee + printing: $4,500 per city (we can provide receipts)
- Lead sharing: CSV of event attendees 48 hours after event; we propose standard opt-in checklist on registration

I've attached a sample floorplan and a short MDF term sheet to speed things up (proposed_floorplan.pdf, MDF_Term_Summary.xlsx).

Would Redwood be open to this? If so I can send a short MOU and a few date options to lock calendars.

Thanks — Maria
Maria Sanchez
Head of Partnerships, BrewTech Labs
maria.sanchez@brewtechlabs.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Hi Maria — great to hear from you and congrats on the concept, it sounds like a nice lightweight format we can support. Looping in Ben (field marketing) and Jonas (events ops) so they can weigh in on staffing and footprint.

A few clarifying questions up front:
- MDF: can you confirm BrewTech's proposed 50/50 split — does $4,500 represent BrewTech's ask per city or the total request?
- Booth footprint: the attached PDF looks like a 10x10. We typically staff two for a 10x10; if we go 10x20 we need an extra headcount.
- Lead capture & privacy: we'll need the attendee opt-in language and where you host registration (Eventbrite/Meetup/custom form). Redwood requires consent prior to sharing CSV.

Proposed next steps: 30-minute call Wednesday 7/15 at 10:00am PT to confirm scope and run a draft MOU. If that works for you, please send calendar invite.

Thanks — Soojin

Subject: Internal: draft MDF split & staffing plan for Inference Cafe

Internal note (please keep internal until we finalize):

Soojin / Grace — following the call I pulled together a draft split and staffing plan for the three-city run. High-level:
- MDF (per city): total $9,000; Redwood contribution (proposed): $4,500 per city (paid as expense reimbursement post-event on receipt).
- Budget line items: coffee + barista $1,200; venue fee $2,000; printing/signage $800; honoraria (local meetup host) $500; contingency $500.
- Staffing: 2 Redwood staff per city for customer-facing shifts (4 hours each). One regional rep per city (rotation) to cover evening networking. Jonas to confirm headcount if we upgrade to 10x20.
- Lead flow & CRM: BrewTech provides CSV 48 hours post event; we'll ingest to HubSpot under 'Inference Cafe - BrewTech' list with source=partner_event. Marketing prefers 1:1 lead transfer only for attendees who opted in.

Open items / asks:
1) Legal: do we need a counter-signed MOU before we book venue deposits? Legal prefers a signed MOU for any MDF > $5k total exposure (across cities). Deal exposure: Redwood total committed if we do 3 cities = $13,500 (exceeds $5k).
2) Finance: Need to confirm whether Redwood pays vendors up front or reimburses BrewTech. Treasury prefers vendor-direct for line items over $2k.
3) Measurement: we should agree on 3 KPIs per city (registrations, demo attendance, follow-up meeting rate).

I've attached the MDF_Term_Summary.xlsx with itemized costs and a sample HubSpot list naming convention.

Ben Carter
Field Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference

Hi Maria — thanks for the fast turnaround and for the DocuSign link. A few consolidated points and proposals from Redwood below so we can finalize the MOU on the call Monday: 

1) MDF & payment path: Redwood can commit to $4,500 per city as reimbursement upon receipt, OR we can pay BrewTech vendor-direct for venue/coffee if BrewTech provides vendor invoices and vendor W9. Finance prefers vendor-direct for any single line item > $2k — can you confirm the preferred flow?

2) Legal / MOU: Redwood legal will review the DocuSign. Given total Redwood exposure across the run will be $13,500, legal prefers a signed MOU BEFORE non-refundable deposits. We can provisionally approve venue deposits up to $2,000 per city pending legal review.

3) Staffing & footprint: we agree to provide 2 staffers per city for a 10x10. Jonas to provide a marked-up floorplan and a short equipment list by 7/20. If BrewTech requests a 10x20 footprint, we will need to confirm +1 staffer per city and update MDF calculations.

4) Lead capture & privacy: Redwood requires Eventbrite registration with an explicit partner-followup opt-in checkbox (sample copy please). BrewTech to deliver CSV 48 hours after event; Redwood will ingest into HubSpot with source metadata as discussed.

5) Logistics: please let us know shipping address for physical collateral. Redwood standard shipping label template attached.

Proposed next steps:
- Monday 7/20: internal legal redline target (Redwood)
- Fri 7/17 10:00am PT: call to sign off operational items (we accepted your 7/15 invite and moved to 7/17 based on internal conflicts)

I'll sign off on the MOU once legal confirms the few redlines. Looking forward to running this with you.

Best,
Soojin
